struttura-again.summary: [FE] - Agenda: Ricerca per struttura: the time slot table mixes two structures
struttura-again.description:
In Agenda I searched by Struttura with SVIL_MS_VISITE, then deleted the text with the backspace key and chose TEST_GEN_25.
The time slot table now shows the slots of both structures. If I press PULISCI before choosing the second one, only TEST_GEN_25 is shown.

birth-date.summary: [FE] - Pazienti: the birth date is saved one day earlier
birth-date.description:
In Anagrafica paziente I type the birth date 14/06/1991 and press SALVA. When I open the patient again the date is 13/06/1991.
Every time the same patient is saved, the date moves back one more day. It happens on every operator PC in Milano and Lodi.

How to reproduce:
1 - Pazienti > NUOVO PAZIENTE
2 - fill in the fields, Data di nascita 14/06/1991
3 - SALVA, then open the patient (Modifica): Data di nascita shows 13/06/1991

expected.cause: toIsoDate() uses Date.toISOString(), i.e. UTC: local midnight in Italy (UTC+1/+2) is the previous day in UTC
expected.introducedBy: CUP_DEMO-2612 (Sara Colombo, 2026-10-20): birth date typed as dd/MM/yyyy
expected.fix: build the ISO string from getFullYear/getMonth/getDate (local), not from toISOString()

cancelled-slot.summary: [BE] - Prenotazioni: a cancelled appointment is never offered again
cancelled-slot.description:
PR-2026-00590 (Costa Andrea, CARDIOLOGIA CASALE, 17/11 at 14:10) was cancelled on 2 November at the patient's request.
In Nuova prenotazione, for CA_CARDIOLOGIA on 17/11 the 14:10 appointment is still missing; all the other times are there.
In September cancelled times were offered again (we tested it then).

expected.cause: BookingRepository.findBookedTimes() does not filter out ANNULLATA bookings, so a cancelled time still counts as booked
expected.introducedBy: CUP_DEMO-2620 (Luca Bianchi, 2026-10-22): one query for the booked times; regression of CUP_DEMO-2533 (Marta asked about it in the review)
expected.fix: add "and b.status <> 'ANNULLATA'" to findBookedTimes (or pass the status), plus a test: cancel → time offered again

annullate-filter.summary: [FE] - Prenotazioni: the Annullate filter shows no bookings
annullate-filter.description:
In Prenotazioni, with Stato = Annullate the table says "Nessuna prenotazione", but PR-2026-00590 is cancelled: it is shown as ANNULLATA with Stato = Tutte.
Confermate and Completate work.

expected.cause: the option value of Annullate is 'ANNULLATE', but the status is 'ANNULLATA': GET /api/bookings?status=ANNULLATE returns nothing
expected.fix: option value="ANNULLATA" (better: options built from the BookingStatus type)
expected._priorArt: K21 (e): a genuinely new problem; prior art must not call it a duplicate or fixed

lab-decimal.summary: [FE] - Inserimento risultati: a value with a decimal comma is saved without its decimals
lab-decimal.description:
In Inserimento risultati I type Creatinina 1,35 and press SALVA: the saved value is 1 (flagged as normal). Potassio 4,6 becomes 4.
It started this week; before, the same values were saved correctly. Values typed with a dot (1.35) are saved right, but everybody types the comma.

How to reproduce:
1 - Richieste > RL-2026-00058 (Ferrari Giulia) > Risultati
2 - Creatinina: type 1,35 and press SALVA
3 - the field shows 1 and the report would say 1 mg/dL

expected.cause: since CUP_LAB-120 the value fields are text fields, and toNumber() uses parseFloat(), which stops at the comma: '1,35' → 1
expected.introducedBy: CUP_LAB-120 (Francesca Lombardi, 2026-10-27): text fields instead of number fields
expected.fix: parse the Italian decimal comma (replace ',' with '.' before Number(), ideally a parseDecimal next to formatDecimal in shared/utils/numbers.ts)

lab-decimal-again._note: K21 (c): the decimal comma bug reported again after LAB-23 fixed it on main (a427822, 2026-11-10). The test environment still runs an older version. LAB-23 is a live ticket: if a demo reset deletes it, update the key.
lab-decimal-again.summary: [FE] - Risultati: Potassio 4,6 is stored as 4 after SALVA
lab-decimal-again.description:
Since this morning in Risultati e referti, when I type Potassio 4,6 and press SALVA, the value shown afterwards is 4. Creatinina 0,95 becomes 0. With a dot it works.
The version installed in COLLAUDO is the one of 3 November.

expected.cause: already fixed on main by LAB-23 (parseDecimal, a427822); the reported version predates the fix
expected.introducedBy: CUP_LAB-120 (Francesca Lombardi, 2026-10-27): text fields instead of number fields

far-renal.summary: [BE] - Nuova prescrizione: no renal warning for metformin, although the patient's eGFR is about 28
far-renal.description:
Marino Paolo (MRNPLA61S03C351V) has creatinine 2,50 mg/dL in MediLab (request of 3 November), eGFR about 28 with the CKD-EPI calculator of the ward. Metformina is contraindicated below 30, but Nuova prescrizione shows no warning at all, and the panel says eGFR 269.
In August the same check worked for him (red warning). Nothing was changed in the drug rules.

How to reproduce:
1 - Nuova prescrizione, patient Marino Paolo
2 - add Metformina 500 mg compresse
3 - the warnings panel shows eGFR 269 and "Nessun avviso"

expected.cause: RenalCheckService always divides the MediLab creatinine by 88.4 (µmol/L → mg/dL), but since CUP_LAB-118 (MediLab, Flyway V6) creatinine comes in mg/dL: 2.50 / 88.4 = 0.028 mg/dL → eGFR far too high. The unit field of the MediLab result is ignored.
expected.introducedBy: CUP_LAB-118 (Alessandro Moretti, MediLab, 2026-10-21): creatinine in mg/dL
expected.fix: convert by the unit MediLab sends (LabValue.unit): mg/dL as is, µmol/L ÷ 88.4, anything else → no eGFR plus an INFO warning; regression test with FakeMediLabClient returning 2.50 mg/dL

bil-cancelled.summary: [BE] - Import addebiti: a cancelled visit is charged to the patient
bil-cancelled.description:
Costa Andrea got a receipt for the cardiology visit of 17/11 (PR-2026-00590), but he cancelled it on 2/11 and MediAgenda shows the booking as ANNULLATA. Other patients called with the same problem since September.

How to reproduce:
1 - Addebiti: import the day 17/11/2026
2 - the visit PR-2026-00590 of Costa Andrea is charged (Prima visita cardiologica, 22,50 €)
3 - in MediAgenda > Prenotazioni the booking is ANNULLATA

expected.cause: the visit import (CUP_BIL-304, June) charges every MediAgenda booking of the day, whatever its status; since CUP_DEMO-2533 (MediAgenda, September) bookings can be ANNULLATA, and those are charged too
expected.introducedBy: CUP_DEMO-2533 (Luca Bianchi, MediAgenda, 2026-09-08): booking cancellation, status ANNULLATA
expected.fix: skip bookings with status ANNULLATA in ChargeImportService.importDay (or charge only CONFERMATA/COMPLETATA), plus a regression test with a cancelled booking in FakeMediAgendaClient
